seattle-start.name: Seattle Public Schools later start
seattle-start.outcome: Start times moved from 7:50 to 8:45 a.m.; teens slept 34 minutes more; biology grades 4.5% higher
seattle-start.limits: Two high schools, one class; observational before/after study.
seattle-start.locator: "from 7:50 a.m. to 8:45 a.m."; "students got 34 minutes more sleep on average"

portugal-no-contact.name: Portugal Law 83/2021 duty of no contact
portugal-no-contact.outcome: Employers barred from contacting staff in rest periods; breach is a grave violation
portugal-no-contact.limits: Legal commentary, not a sleep outcome study; enforcement data not found.
portugal-no-contact.locator: Article 199-A; "except in situations of force majeure"

paris-meduse.name: Méduse noise camera
paris-meduse.outcome: Microphones plus camera identify loud vehicles by plate; fines planned from 2023
paris-meduse.limits: Trial stage in 2022; fine start date and amounts not confirmed.
paris-meduse.locator: "The idea is to fine loud vehicles, all vehicles"

nice-sleepio.name: NICE guidance on Sleepio digital CBT-I
nice-sleepio.outcome: Recommended over sleeping pills after 12 randomised trials
nice-sleepio.limits: Vendor-funded trials among the 12; NHS access varies by area.
nice-sleepio.locator: "more effective at reducing insomnia than sleep hygiene and sleeping pills"

habit-nurses.name: HABIT trial: nurse-delivered sleep restriction
habit-nurses.outcome: 642 adults; four short nurse sessions cut insomnia scores by 3 points vs leaflet
habit-nurses.limits: Sleep restriction is not advised for some conditions (e.g. bipolar, seizures); needs a clinician.

frankfurt-nights.name: Frankfurt night-flight ban
frankfurt-nights.outcome: Court barred flights 11pm–5am after residents sued
frankfurt-nights.limits: Won as part of a runway expansion fight; airlines opposed; specific legal context.
frankfurt-nights.locator: "sticking to its stance on the night flight ban"

aasm-standard-time.name: American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) position: permanent standard time
aasm-standard-time.outcome: Sleep doctors call to end clock changes and keep standard time
aasm-standard-time.limits: Position statement, not a law; Congress has debated permanent daylight time instead.
aasm-standard-time.locator: Title: "an American Academy of Sleep Medicine position statement"

police-forward.name: North Yorkshire Police forward-rotating shifts
police-forward.outcome: Day→afternoon→night then 4 days off; night shifts still cost ~2 hours of sleep; two drivers reported nodding off
police-forward.limits: 23 people, no comparison group; forward rotation evidence overall is weak.
police-forward.locator: "sleep duration was significantly reduced, by around 2 hours, while working night shifts"

aasm-sleep-apart.name: AASM survey on sleeping apart
aasm-sleep-apart.outcome: 35% of adults sleep in another room from a partner at least sometimes
aasm-sleep-apart.limits: Online poll; says nothing about relationship quality.

crazy-inc.name: Crazy Inc. sleep points
crazy-inc.outcome: Staff sleeping 6+ hours five nights a week earn up to ¥64,000 ($570) a year in cafeteria points
crazy-inc.limits: One small firm; tracking raises privacy concerns; no outcome data.
crazy-inc.locator: "as much as 64,000 yen ($570) per year"; wedding-planning firm

apple-apnea.name: Apple Watch sleep apnea notification
apple-apnea.outcome: Over-the-counter risk check after 10 nights of tracking
apple-apnea.limits: Screening only, not diagnosis; expensive device; misses some cases.
apple-apnea.locator: FDA class: "over-the-counter device to assess risk of sleep apnea"

barcelona-superblocks.name: Barcelona superblocks
barcelona-superblocks.outcome: Traffic removed from inner streets; noise reported lower
barcelona-superblocks.limits: Decibel figures seen only in secondary sources; noise may shift to edge streets.

spain-time-zone.name: Campaign to return Spain to its natural time zone
spain-time-zone.limits: Statistics on Spanish sleep loss seen only on low-quality sites.

northwestern-light.name: Northwestern Medicine light-during-sleep study
northwestern-light.outcome: One night with room light (100 lux) raised heart rate and next-morning insulin resistance vs dim light (3 lux)
northwestern-light.limits: Small lab study (20 young adults), one night; long-term effects unknown.
northwestern-light.locator: Advice: blackout shades or an eye mask if outdoor light can’t be controlled

noise-review.name: Systematic review of white and pink noise for sleep (Capezuti et al.)
noise-review.outcome: 34 studies; 9 of 11 pink-noise studies positive, under a third of white-noise studies
noise-review.limits: Most studies small and at risk of bias; no harms reported short term.
noise-review.locator: "no strong evidence to support use of auditory stimulation"

ozlo-sleepbuds.name: Ozlo Sleepbuds noise-masking earbuds
ozlo-sleepbuds.outcome: $279; passive seal plus masking sounds, up to 14 hours a charge
ozlo-sleepbuds.limits: Manufacturer’s own page; effectiveness claims not independently tested.
ozlo-sleepbuds.locator: "block and replace" noise-masking, not active noise cancellation

consensus-diary.name: Consensus Sleep Diary (Carney et al.)
consensus-diary.outcome: A standard 9-question morning diary built by 25 insomnia experts
consensus-diary.limits: A research and clinical tool; the authors call it a living document.

resistbot.name: Resistbot
resistbot.outcome: Nearly 10 million users sent 35 million letters to officials by 2023
resistbot.limits: Wikipedia summary; letters sent is not influence gained.
resistbot.locator: Users text; it finds their federal, state and city officials

aasm-directory.name: AASM Sleep Center Directory
aasm-directory.outcome: Directory of accredited sleep centers on sleepeducation.org
aasm-directory.limits: Opened page lists the directory but its search features were not confirmed.

bts-noise-map.name: National Transportation Noise Map (U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics)
bts-noise-map.outcome: Public map of modeled aviation and Interstate highway noise, viewable down to county level
bts-noise-map.limits: Shows modeled potential exposure, not measured noise at a home; meant for trends, not impacts.
bts-noise-map.locator: "U.S. Department of Transportation's Bureau of Transportation Statistics"; "national picture of potential exposure to aviation and highway noise"

faa-noise-complaints.name: FAA guidance on aircraft noise complaints
faa-noise-complaints.outcome: Airport first, then the FAA noise portal and a regional ombudsman
faa-noise-complaints.limits: Page blocked automated access; seen only in search summaries.
